title: Functional Limit Theorems for Random Least Common Multiples
summary: Let $A_n$ be a subset of $\{1,2,\ldots,n\}$ obtained by retaining each integer independently with fixed probability $θ\in(0,1)$, and let $L_n$ be the least common multiple of the integers in $A_n$. We prove a functional large deviation principle, a functional moderate deviation principle, and a Strassen-type functional law of the iterated logarithm for the process $(\log L_{\lfloor{nt}\rfloor})_{0\le t\le1}$.
